title: $D$-elliptic modular curves $X_0(N)$
summary: We present a method for determining whether there exists a degree $D$ rational map from $X_0(N)$ to some elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$. Moreover, we explain how to obtain a quadratic form that represents all possible degrees of such maps using the degree pairing method. This method previously required odd analytic rank and some additional technical conditions to be satisfied. In this paper, we extended the method to even rank curves as well and remove all technical conditions.
